title: The Descent into Hades
lead: The belief that Christ, between his death and resurrection, went to the realm of the dead. The idea draws on 1 Peter 3:19, Acts 2:27 and Ephesians 4:9, and appears in the Apostles' Creed ("he descended to the dead" or "into hell"). Christians differ over what it was: victory, preaching, suffering, or simply being dead.
